ap_halo.explanation: Multi-ring AP pattern (1 radial peaks, mimic score 0.76). May be button battery OR stacked coins. Obtain lateral view and treat as battery until ruled out.

lat_halo.explanation: No distinct round foreign body detected. If ingestion suspected, obtain dedicated AP/lateral neck or chest films.
